summaryZh: Moore 研究组研究与传播优化放疗计划的最佳实践，利用既往临床经验定量改进未来患者的放疗。团队采用基于知识的计划方法。

evidence.quote: Dr. Kevin Moore Dr. Moore's research group is dedicated to the dissemination of the best practices in optimized radiotherapy planning. Though the mathematical methods can be complex, the logic behind knowledge-based planning is extremely simple: use past clinical experience to quantitatively inform and improve the practice of radiotherapy for future patients. We hope to serve a direct clinical need by educating clinicians in how to understand and safely adopt knowledge-based methods in their radiotherapy practice. Support Dr. Moore's research is supported in part by a 5-year, $1.9M R01 grant from the Agency of Healthcare Research and Quality.
